summary: All 81 requirements are implemented in two controllers (GasAnalysis, Movement). Values and choices the requirements leave open are listed below; none blocks verification.

issues.title: Values of the configuration constants
issues.raw: CD-Const1..6 say the constants are configured at start-up but give no values.
issues.fix_directive: Chosen: THR=2.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=3, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=2. All are integer-valued, so the model's round-up of fractional constants changes nothing. Replace with deployment values if known.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: Only gs has a stated initial value (empty). sts, ins, anl, a, l, d0, d1 and the evasion timer have none.
issues.fix_directive: Chosen: sts=noGas, ins=0.0, anl=Front, a=Front, l=front, d0=d1=0.0, evasionStart=0. Each is overwritten before it is read on every path.

issues.title: Mapping from sensor position to Angle
issues.raw: CD-DM7/CD-Fn3: the 1-based position maps to a sensing direction via angle(x), which is not defined.
issues.fix_directive: Chosen: positions 1,2,3,4 map to Left, Right, Back, Front (enum order), cycling for longer readings; ties go to the lowest position.

issues.title: What 'indicates the target chemical' means in analysis
issues.raw: CD-Fn1 does not define when a reading indicates the target, nor where the target identity comes from.
issues.fix_directive: A sensor value indicates the target when its chemical equals the target Chem passed to the ChemicalSensor constructor and its intensity is positive.

issues.title: intensity and location ignore the chemical identity
issues.raw: CD-Fn2/CD-Fn3 take the maximum over every sensor value in the reading, so another chemical's stronger signal can set ins and the turn direction.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented literally (maximum over all values). Restrict to target-chemical values if that was intended.

issues.title: Intensity as real, operations as Vehicle methods, odometer as a sampled sensor
issues.raw: Intensity (CD-DM5) has no Java type; the four operations (CD-OP1..4) are parameterised commands with no computed result; the odometer (CD-Evt3) is sampled inside actions.
issues.fix_directive: Intensity is double (real) with goreq as its order. move, randomWalk, shortRandomWalk, changeDirection and delay (the wait) are Vehicle methods, not compute()-style operation classes, because they take arguments and return nothing. The odometer is VehicleSensor.odometer(), read into d0/d1.

issues.title: Waiting's during action, terminal states and the evasion timer
issues.raw: The profile has no during actions or final states; CD-MV-Clock1 restarts the timer 'on entry to Avoiding'.
issues.fix_directive: randomWalk() runs on every transition into Waiting and once in the MovementController constructor. GasAnalysis concludes in a terminal mode Final (CD-GA-Beh6); Found is terminal (CD-MV-Beh9 has no transition). The timer is restarted with Avoiding's entry actions on both transitions into Avoiding. In Java, an event a mode does not handle is dropped for that cycle.

next_step: Run the pipeline; revisit an item only if a verifier or the vacuity audit points at it.
